title: tapper user/project config
description: Schema for tapper user or project configuration.

defaultKeg.description: Alias used when no explicit keg is requested. Override with TAP_DEFAULT_KEG env var.

fallbackKeg.description: Last-resort keg alias used when no mapped or default alias resolves. Override with TAP_FALLBACK_KEG env var.

defaultRegistry.description: Registry name used by default for API-style targets. Override with TAP_DEFAULT_REGISTRY env var.

kegSearchPaths.description: One path or a list of paths scanned for file-backed kegs. Override with TAP_KEG_SEARCH_PATHS env var (colon-separated).

oneOf.description: Single directory path used for keg discovery.
Ordered list of directory paths used for keg discovery.

items.description: Directory path used for keg discovery.

kegs.description: Map of alias names to keg target definitions.

file.description: Filesystem path for a local keg target.

repo.description: Registry name for an API-style target.

url.description: Full URL target for remote access.

memory.description: When true, use an in-memory keg target.

user.description: User or namespace component for API-style targets.

keg.description: Keg name component for API-style targets.

token.description: Inline token credential for URL or registry targets.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable name containing a token credential.

kegMap.description: Path-based rules that map files to keg aliases.

alias.description: Keg alias selected when this rule matches.

pathPrefix.description: Path prefix that must match the current path.

pathRegex.description: Regular expression used to match the current path.

registries.description: List of named registry connection definitions.

name.description: Registry identifier referenced by targets and defaults.

url.description: Base URL or host for the registry.

token.description: Inline token credential for registry access.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the registry token.

logFile.description: Path to the log output file. Override with TAP_LOG_FILE env var.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error). Override with TAP_LOG_LEVEL env var.

updated.description: RFC3339 timestamp for the last config update.
